key_results: The hand-derived five-job fixture produces project duration 5 with two equal critical branches, a zero milestone and a disconnected zero job with slack 5. The transitive milestone→Finish edge remains a prerequisite but is correctly excluded from tight critical edges.

Changing Right from 2 to 1 synchronously clears the previous result/export before an attempted same-task download activation, then recomputes slack 1 and removes that branch from the critical set without changing project duration 5.
Adding a cycle refuses finite timing and old exports. Blank, signed, decimal, exponent, comma-separated and out-of-range duration strings produce visible refusal.
All-zero jobs with prototype-like and literal-markup names retain exact names, timing and trace bytes; no b element is interpreted from the literal name.

The 375px sequence reaches, edits and activates controls using Tab/Control+A/text entry/Enter. Document and body remain 375px wide; the exact-time table has its own contained horizontal scroll region.
